name: if
reason: CmathErrGlue restates protectedRet case by case (proved by cases and simp), the cmath docs promise no such mapping, and no claimed function's theorem runs through the Py_complex_protected converter (acos through tanh, exp, sqrt and log10 are todo), so no Python-visible behaviour of this EDOM branch is pinned.

name: if
reason: As for the EDOM branch: the ERANGE branch is only restated by CmathErrGlue, and no claimed function's theorem goes through the converter, so nothing Python-visible about it is pinned.

name: special_type
reason: SpecialTypeDoc characterises each of the seven classes by an iff, which determines special_type (the enum citation :105-113 is two lines early; the enum is at :107-115).

name: cmath_log_impl
reason: CmathLogBase covers a base whose c_log sets no errno or is zero (base 1), and the refutation concerns c_log(x)'s errno, but a base whose own c_log sets errno (base 0j, EDOM at :621-623, so cmath.log(1, 0) raises ValueError) is unconstrained, so a version that ignores errno whenever a base is given passes.

name: math_error
reason: CmathErrGlue gives math_error's value for EDOM, ERANGE and any other errno, and PhasePolar, RectDoc and CmathLogBase reach it through phase, rect and log.

name: cmath_phase_impl
reason: PhasePolar: phase equals math.atan2(z.imag, z.real) for every Annex F atan2 and raises math_error exactly when atan2 sets errno; the C23 underflow case is on record as refuted with bugs/mathint-cmath-phase-underflow.yaml.

name: cmath_polar_impl
reason: PhasePolar determines polar for every atan2 and hypot: (abs(z), atan2(z.imag, z.real)) when _Py_c_abs succeeds, OverflowError('math range error') when it overflows, with atan2's errno discarded as 3.15 does.

name: cmath_rect_impl
reason: RectDoc pins finite arguments, when ValueError is raised and the infinite-r, finite-nonzero-phi branch, but none of the rect_special_values entries (:1052-1060) returned for the other non-finite cases (rect(inf, 0.0), rect(0.0, inf), rect(nan, x), rect(x, nan)) is stated, so a wrong table entry passes.

name: cmath_isfinite_impl
reason: CmathPredicates: both parts finite, as the docs state, and isfinite(z) == (not isinf(z) and not isnan(z)).

name: cmath_isnan_impl
reason: CmathPredicates: either part a NaN, and tied to isfinite and isinf by isfinite(z) == (not isinf(z) and not isnan(z)), so an '&&' version fails.

name: cmath_isinf_impl
reason: CmathPredicates: either part infinite, tied to isfinite and isnan by the same invariant, and isinf implies not isfinite.

name: cmath_isclose_impl
reason: CmathIsClose determines isclose for every hypot (negative-tolerance ValueError, part-wise equality, the infinity rule, the three-way test with _Py_c_abs), and the docstring's NaN rule is refuted with bugs/mathint-cmath-isclose-nan-inf-tol.yaml.

name: PyInit_cmath
reason: internal-bootstrap applies: the body only returns PyModuleDef_Init(&cmathmodule).
